what: An aggressive monophonic virtual analog synth after the Arturia MiniBrute: Ultrasaw, PWM square, Metalizer triangle, sub and noise into a resonant multimode filter with Brute Factor. Two envelopes, LFO, arpeggiator, 64-step sequencer, five effects and 128 patch slots.
author: Leonardo Lopez Chavira
sounds: own: synth patches only (parameter settings, no samples), programmed for MB-1; A01-A23 approximate sounds of Arturia MiniBrute V factory presets, A24-A32 were made with MB-1's RANDOM

smk37.what: MB-1 on the SMK-37 Pro with a MiniBrute-style panel: the faders are the oscillator mixer, eight knobs for Ultrasaw, Metalizer, Brute, cutoff, resonance, env amount, decay/release and LFO rate. 37 velocity keys, wheels, sustain, and the pads and a piano roll for the 64-step sequencer.
